clue.text: Open an eye and get off the line?

definitions.meaning: free a hook-and-eye fastening by releasing its catch from the loop
release a caught fish from the angler's fishing line

explanation.surface: Someone wakes up blearily and abandons the phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'eye' is not a body part but the loop of a hook-and-eye fastening on clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean freeing something from a hook: a dress fastening or a landed fish.

clue.text: Recovery vessel — put out in it

indicators.note: put out suggests the word is upset or disordered, so its letters move

parts.note: an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: A salvage ship is put to sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges PUT to UPT; 'in it' only places UPT with the URN.
explanation.definitionFit: An upturn is an improvement, as in economic recovery.

clue.text: Having ruined hock, perhaps

parts.note: cutting the tendon behind an animal's hock joint lames it

explanation.surface: Someone has spoiled a bottle of German white wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hock' seems to be the wine, but it is the joint in a horse's hind leg whose tendon is cut.
explanation.definitionFit: To hamstring an animal is to cut the tendon at the back of its hind leg, crippling it.

clue.text: Individual put on a little weight — it's something in the air

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece put on another sits beneath it

parts.note: oz is the abbreviation for ounce, a small weight
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: Someone has put on a little weight, and it shows.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is a form of oxygen present in the atmosphere, popularly fresh sea air.

clue.text: Drink that may lead to a smash

definitions.meaning: a tall mixed drink of spirits and soda served with ice

definitions.text: that may lead to a smash
definitions.meaning: in tennis a lofted return invites the opponent's overhead smash

explanation.surface: A cocktail strong enough to end in a car crash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smash' seems to promise drunken damage, but it is the tennis overhead shot played off a lofted lob.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a whisky-and-soda cocktail and a lofted shot in racket sports.

clue.text: Perfect profession for an entrepreneur?

definitions.meaning: a trader professing or declaring his trade would say '...'

explanation.surface: Running a business is the perfect career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Profession' looks like a career, but it means a declaration: the trader says I DEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Perfect and model are synonyms for flawless; the second reading splits it as I DEAL.

clue.text: Card woollen material that's genuine

parts.note: a heart is a playing card of that suit
felt is a cloth made of matted wool

explanation.surface: A greetings card made of real wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartfelt feelings are sincere and deeply felt.

clue.text: A special guru or prophet

indicators.note: a special arrangement makes the letters of the next word into a new order

explanation.surface: A remarkable spiritual teacher who foretells the future.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special' rearranges GURU to UGUR.
explanation.definitionFit: An augur was a Roman seer who foretold events, so a soothsayer.

clue.text: Final appointment that precedes military retirement

definitions.meaning: the last job or posting in a career
the bugle call sounded before retiring at night in the army

explanation.surface: An officer's last posting before leaving the army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' seems to mean leaving service, but it is going to bed; the bugle call also sounds at funerals.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a final posting and also the bugle call sounding the end of the day.

clue.text: Seize with force after I'd taken over

indicators.note: the force piece follows the I'd piece in the answer
in a down answer a word taken over is turned upside down, so read from bottom up

parts.note: I'd is written as the letters I and D
strain is force or pressure

explanation.surface: Someone grabs something by force after taking charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken over' turns ID into DI.
explanation.definitionFit: To distrain is to seize goods in law, as security for a debt.

clue.text: Procrastinate when it's time to get up

parts.note: in music, tempo is the time or speed of a piece
to rise is to get up out of bed

explanation.surface: Someone dawdles in bed every morning when the alarm goes off.
explanation.definitionFit: To temporise is to stall and play for time, avoiding a decision.

clue.text: A brief, for example, is for the defence

parts.note: the brief or shortened form of 'for example' is e.g.
taken as written

explanation.surface: A barrister's brief is a document prepared to help the defence in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brief' looks like a legal document, but it says that 'for example' is shortened to EG.
explanation.definitionFit: Under someone's aegis means under their protection; the aegis was Zeus's protective shield.

clue.text: The only thing an exhausted army can beat?

definitions.text: The only thing an exhausted army can beat?

parts.words: The only thing an exhausted army can beat?
parts.note: a worn-out army cannot defeat anyone, but it can still 'beat' a withdrawal, the idiom for falling back

explanation.surface: A depleted army is in no state to win any battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' reads as defeat, but the idiom 'beat a hasty withdrawal' uses it for running away.
explanation.definitionFit: A military withdrawal from the enemy is what an army 'beats' in the idiom.

clue.text: Goes flat out arranging tenancies to rent

parts.note: a landlord who arranges tenancies lets property
a rent is a tear in cloth, so a rip

explanation.surface: A busy letting agent races about fixing up rental agreements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' seems to be the money paid by tenants, but here it is a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: To go at full speed without restraint is to let rip, an informal idiom.

clue.text: Highlights of an Arctic cruise, perhaps?

definitions.text: Highlights of an Arctic cruise, perhaps?

parts.words: Highlights of an Arctic cruise, perhaps?
parts.note: the best moments of a polar voyage could literally be lights in the northern sky

explanation.surface: The brochure lists the best moments of a voyage north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Highlights' reads as best moments, but it is meant literally: lights high in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: The northern lights are glowing displays in the polar sky, a sight Arctic cruises sell.

clue.text: It's extensively used by an oarsman

definitions.text: It's extensively used by an oarsman

parts.words: It's extensively used by an oarsman
parts.note: a frame that extends out from a rowing boat to hold the rowlock

explanation.surface: A rower makes heavy use of some piece of kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extensively' seems to mean often, but this fitting literally extends from the side of the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: This bracket projects from a rowing boat's side to carry the rowlock.

clue.text: Clue one composed about power and riches

indicators.note: the reworked letters go around the power piece
composed means arranged or put together, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: A setter writes a clue about power and wealth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' rearranges CLUE ONE to OULENCE; 'about' puts it around P.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulence is great wealth and luxury.

clue.text: Hit oddly shaped cover on light

parts.note: to lam is to thrash or hit

indicators.note: something done oddly is done strangely, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone strikes a strangely shaped lamp cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' rearranges SHAPED to PSHADE; 'oddly' does not here mean odd-numbered letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A shade fitted over a bulb or lamp to soften its glare.

clue.text: Launching of report on cricket side

parts.note: a report is a loud bang, a blast
the off side is one half of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A news report about a cricket team starting its season.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field divides into the off side and the leg side.
explanation.definitionFit: Blast-off is the launch of a rocket.

clue.text: You should be switched on by this

definitions.text: You should be switched on by this

parts.words: You should be switched on by this
parts.note: road users must have their vehicle lights on from the official hour after dusk

explanation.surface: A motivational speaker promises an inspiring talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Switched on' seems to mean alert or excited, but it refers to a car's lamps being turned on at dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the legal hour after sunset from which vehicles must show headlights.

clue.text: Know about any transported from part of East Africa

parts.note: to ken is to know about, in Scots and old usage

indicators.note: transported means carried away, so the letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone knows about people being shipped from East Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transported' rearranges ANY to YAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A Kenyan is a person or thing from Kenya, in East Africa.

clue.text: Notices faulty part

indicators.note: something faulty is broken or wrong, so the letters of the word before are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone notices that a component is defective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faulty' rearranges the letters of NOTICES.
explanation.definitionFit: A section is a portion or piece of a whole.

clue.text: Infant learner told off, put outside

indicators.note: the scolding word is put outside the learner, enclosing it

parts.note: chid is an old past tense of chide, to scold
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A young pupil is scolded and sent out of the room.
explanation.definitionFit: A child is a young person, as an infant is.

clue.text: Lack of practice for players in group

parts.note: no means none of, a lack of
nets are cricket practice areas, so a net is a practice session

explanation.surface: A team plays badly because it has not practised.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, practice sessions in netted lanes are called nets.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine musicians or players.

clue.text: In a group, coming from France

definitions.text: In a group, coming from France

parts.words: In a group, coming from France
parts.note: the French borrowed phrase for all together, as a mass

explanation.surface: A party of tourists arrives together off the ferry from France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming from France' says the phrase is borrowed from French.
explanation.definitionFit: The borrowed French phrase means all together, as one body.

clue.text: Flight leader

parts.note: the man who led the Israelites' flight out of Egypt

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' reads as aircraft, but it is the Exodus, the escape from Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible's Exodus tells of this prophet leading the Israelites out of Egypt.

clue.text: Still to be paid nothing to fly

parts.note: zero, nothing, looks like the letter O
to wing is to fly

explanation.surface: Someone flies off without settling the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt owing is one that remains outstanding and unpaid.

clue.text: Shift scenery as required

indicators.note: shifting moves things about, so these letters change places

explanation.surface: Stagehands move the set when told to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shift' rearranges the letters of SCENERY AS.
explanation.definitionFit: What is needed or essential is necessary.

clue.text: Make a union defer tea break

indicators.note: breaking something smashes it up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Union officials postpone their tea break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' rearranges the letters of DEFER TEA; 'union' suggests a trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: To federate is to join states or bodies together in a federation.

clue.text: Like three articles in the wash

parts.note: as means like, in comparisons
a tern is a set of three things

explanation.surface: Several items of clothing are going round in the washing machine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The wash' is not laundry but the wake a ship leaves behind it; TERN is an old word for a trio.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind a ship, in its wake, is astern.
